Repository Evidence and Navigation
|-- Resolve an explicit source -> resolveDiagramSource() [shared A]
|   |-- Load project; reject a mismatched projectId
|   |-- Choose diagram or registered binding
|   |   |-- Live diagram -> validate; check requested contentId
|   |   |-- Saved representation -> requested revision or current revision
|   |   |   |-- Require revision to belong to representation
|   |   |   `-- Select contentId, or require exactly one source-bound diagram
|   |   `-- Source query -> saved diagram bindings + project.sources
|   |       |-- Filter by sourceId when supplied; deduplicate by sourceId
|   |       |-- Reject conflicting corpus root, kind, or repository identity
|   |       `-- Require exactly one binding -> temporary source-query diagram
|   |-- Requested sourceId must match the selected diagram's binding
|   `-- Return diagramSource query + diagram + binding() + readText/listFiles
|       |-- binding() fails when the diagram has no source repository
|       `-- Reads/listings require CorpusAccess -> provider(binding.corpus) [shared B]
|-- Corpus access: filesystem content behind a binding [shared B]
|   |-- CorpusBinding
|   |   |-- git-worktree: root + optional revision
|   |   `-- filesystem-documents: root
|   |-- CorpusAccess contract -> provider, readDocumentLines, discover
|   |-- Both supplied providers use filesystem reads under the bound root
|   |   |-- Check provider kind; canonicalize root; require a directory
|   |   |-- Require relative paths; reject NUL, backslash, '.', '..', empty segments
|   |   `-- Reject symlink traversal and paths escaping the root
|   |-- listDirectory -> omit .git; directories first, then names
|   `-- readDocumentBytes -> UTF-8 text -> lines
|       `-- readLines(range) -> validate one-based inclusive bounds; slice to file end
|-- Git identity and change context -> GitRepositoryRegistry
|   |-- Persist repositories in project.json; serialize mutations per store file
|   |-- initialize/register -> discover Git identity
|   |   |-- Stable repository ID = prefix + truncated SHA-256 of identity
|   |   |-- Merge checkout roots for the same identity
|   |   `-- Initialization backfills discoverable repositories; non-Git roots stay unassigned
|   |-- Resolve usable checkout
|   |   |-- Try saved roots and current checkout; require matching Git identity
|   |   `-- No matching checkout -> repository unavailable
|   `-- resolveContext / captureHunks
|       |-- Require repositoryId unless exactly one repository is registered
|       |-- Resolve head, commits, optional comparisonBase to commit SHAs
|       `-- Validate repository context -> capture Git hunks from that checkout
|-- Diagram selection -> source evidence [codePanel.ts]
|   |-- Require sourceContext.contentHash == content.asciiSha256
|   |-- diagramSource.entries() -> mappings with node, entity, and range
|   |   `-- SourceRangeReference
|   |       |-- repo = projectId + entity.sourceId, falling back to binding.sourceId
|   |       |-- path + inclusive one-based startLine/endLine
|   |       `-- rangeSha256 = hash of original evidence lines joined by LF
|   |-- Sort selected nodes by diagram position -> resolveNodeResources()
|   |   |-- Preserve selected-node and mapped-node origins
|   |   `-- Report unmappedNodeIds
|   |-- Deduplicate resources by type + repo + path + bounds + range hash
|   |   `-- Merge origins -> PanelContent with diagram/revision/content identity
|   `-- Build display sections in diagram order
|       |-- New section when repository/file changes or start lines go backwards
|       `-- Merge overlapping ranges within a section
|-- Browser source boundary -> CodeRepoService
|   |-- Every repository reference carries projectId + sourceId
|   |   `-- A canvas can span repositories; project identity alone is insufficient
|   |-- HTTP implementation
|   |   |-- read/preload -> sourceFilesClient()
|   |   |-- listDirectory -> fetchProjectDirectory()
|   |   |-- definitions -> fetchSourceDefinitions()
|   |   `-- Search and all Git methods -> unsupported-operation error
|   |-- SourceFileCache -> shared promises keyed by projectId + sourceId + path
|   |   |-- Reuse unless reload or both supplied/cached versions differ
|   |   |-- Background and on-demand reads share a queue; default concurrency = 4
|   |   |-- On-demand work moves ahead of queued background work
|   |   `-- Failed current entries are removed -> later reads can retry
|   |-- ProjectSourceService -> resolve through [shared A]
|   |   |-- files(directory) -> source.listFiles(directory)
|   |   |-- source(path) -> require path -> source.readText(path)
|   |   |   |-- Reject NUL-containing binary content
|   |   |   `-- Return path, lines, startLine=1, SHA-256, and lspEnabled
|   |   `-- definitions -> optional language service using bound corpus [shared C]
|   `-- SourceCodePane -> repository explorer + current file + mapped ranges
|       |-- Read on project/source/path/retry changes; abort obsolete pane requests
|       |-- Loading/error states -> retry or explicit reload
|       |-- Compare loaded file SHA-256 with projection's sourceSha256
|       |   |-- Match -> range highlights, mapped-range navigation, optional compaction
|       |   `-- Mismatch -> current text with stale warning; disable highlights/folds
|       |-- Open file / follow definition -> navigate within the existing pane
|       |   `-- Back/forward history retains range and scroll position
|       `-- SourceCodeView -> read-only code or plain text
|           |-- Token highlighting with text fallback; configurable wrapping
|           |-- Compacted sections -> reveal full source or individual graph-node ranges
|           |-- Restore scroll; reveal destination and expand its enclosing fold
|           `-- Ctrl/Cmd+click or F12 -> source position -> definition lookup [shared C]
`-- Optional definition lookup [shared C]
    |-- No language service -> lsp-disabled; server must enable --lsp
    |-- ProjectLanguageService validates request
    |   |-- Supported TypeScript/JavaScript path + nonnegative integer position
    |   |-- Re-read through corpus provider [shared B]
    |   |-- Disk SHA-256 must match requested sourceSha256; otherwise require reload
    |   `-- Position must be inside file; coordinates are zero-based UTF-16
    |-- One lazy language-server session per canonical root, shared across panes
    |   |-- Start TypeScript language server over stdio JSON-RPC
    |   |-- Initialize with definition support and UTF-16 encoding
    |   |-- Serialize lookups -> didOpen -> definition request -> didClose
    |   |-- AbortSignal -> RPC cancellation
    |   `-- 20-second initialization/request bounds; dispose on failure or 5-minute idle
    |       `-- Shutdown disposes sessions; a later lookup replaces a dead session
    `-- Normalize definition results -> deduplicated relative locations + outsideRoot count
        |-- Non-file URIs or invalid repository-relative paths -> outsideRoot count
        |-- One location -> pane navigates immediately
        |-- Multiple locations -> user chooses a destination
        `-- No locations -> outside-repository or no-definition message
